$comment: ACCEPTED OpenAPI DRIFT BASELINE — read this before editing.
Purpose: the local snapshot (AstrBot OpenAPI v1.json) intentionally stays at the
4.28-era baseline. Users on older cores plus a newer skill are a supported
combination, so the snapshot must not silently follow the newest spec. That means
check_openapi_drift.py will permanently see the same delta against live; without
this file exactly the same entries are re-reported on every run, which buries NEW
Behaviour: check_openapi_drift.py subtracts 'accepted_drift' from the raw delta.
- drift covered here  -> reported as accepted (quiet, exit 0)
- drift NOT here      -> reported as NEW (exit 2, or 1 if it touches runtime)
- entries here that no longer appear in the raw delta -> reported as STALE
Do NOT add an entry just to silence a failure. Every entry needs a real PR/issue
reference and a note explaining why older cores are unaffected.
Every entry in accepted_drift has a matching entry in 'annotations' below.

meta.runtime_impact: none — no endpoint used by mcp/runtime/*.py matches an accepted entry
meta.policy: Keep the snapshot at the older baseline for old-core compatibility; annotate instead of refreshing.

/api/v1/plugins/views.summary: List plugin views (query plugin_id). Canonical replacement for /plugins/pages.
/api/v1/plugins/views.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Plugins there ship pages/ only; nothing calls this route from mcp/runtime.

/api/v1/plugins/view.summary: View entry HTML by query plugin_id + page_name (query param name kept for wire compat).
/api/v1/plugins/view.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1; the old core serves /plugins/page instead.

/api/v1/plugins/{}/views.summary: List plugin views for one plugin.
/api/v1/plugins/{}/views.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1; the page-named alias exists only on 4.29+.

/api/v1/plugins/{}/views/{}.summary: View entry HTML. Also backs the scoped path-token asset route /views/{view}/_t/{token}/...
/api/v1/plugins/{}/views/{}.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Those cores rewrite relative asset URLs server-side instead; a plugin using plain RELATIVE asset paths works on both.

/api/v1/plugins/page/assets.summary: Authenticated page-asset route removed — superseded by the path-token view asset route.
/api/v1/plugins/page/assets.old_core_note: Still present on <=4.28.1, which is why the snapshot lists it. Never called by mcp/runtime.

/api/v1/plugins/{}/pages/{}/assets/{}.summary: Per-page asset route removed for the same reason; it had no callers outside the generated client.
/api/v1/plugins/{}/pages/{}/assets/{}.old_core_note: Still present on <=4.28.1. Never called by mcp/runtime.

/api/v1/files/upload/init.summary: Chunked upload init for CHAT ATTACHMENTS (ChatUploadInitRequest).
/api/v1/files/upload/init.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. UNRELATED to plugin install: /api/v1/plugins/install/upload is still single-shot multipart and unchanged, so Scheme A is unaffected.

/api/v1/files/upload/chunk.summary: Chunked upload part (multipart: upload_id, chunk_index, chunk).
/api/v1/files/upload/chunk.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Chat attachments only; owner-scoped.

/api/v1/files/upload/complete.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Not used by mcp/runtime.

/api/v1/files/upload/abort.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Not used by mcp/runtime.

/api/v1/files/upload/status.summary: Query a chunked chat upload session (resume support).
/api/v1/files/upload/status.old_core_note: Absent on <=4.28.1. Not used by mcp/runtime.
